summary_markdown: The initial discussion focused on refining the data processing requirements. It was clarified that the analysis should be performed on parsed sessions, not raw packages. Specifically, two components were excluded from the processing: anomaly detection and permanent identifiers (permanents). The processed file containing device session data for 2023-07-08 has been delivered. Finally, a timeline estimate was provided for fixing/implementing dwell time analysis, expected by the end of next week.
decisions: Data processing will focus on parsed sessions only.
Anomaly detection is excluded from session processing.
Permanent identifiers are not required in the sessions.
Dwell time fix/implementation is targeted for the end of next week.
